dedupe_keys.name: sao sebastiao 2 m terrain model and land surface parameters

description: The São Sebastião research team publishes a two-metre bare-earth digital terrain model and derived land-surface parameters for this coastal municipality in São Paulo state, Brazil. The article explains that the product comes from 2023–2024 airborne lidar point clouds and includes slope, aspect, curvature, drainage and other terrain layers. The raw lidar cannot be redistributed under the source agreement, but the derivative raster products are public on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no stated cost. The article reports compressed TIFF outputs in WGS84/UTM zone 23S. These layers can supply topography to landslide, debris-flow, road disruption and stormwater simulations in a municipality damaged by the February 2023 rain event. A two-metre grid still requires careful drainage and building representation at asset scale. The comparison with old topographic maps has systematic vertical differences in densely vegetated terrain, so the article's vertical-error numbers should not be treated as absolute measurement accuracy. This municipality's package is distinct from the Ilhabela DOI and complements data-ahn-netherlands-elevation-model as another regional terrain source. No TIFF or raw lidar was downloaded.
